idea-plugin.name: ANTLR v4
idea-plugin.description:
This plugin is for ANTLR v4 grammars and includes ANTLR 4.13.2. It works with 2022.3 and above. It should work in other JetBrains IDEs.

  • syntax highlighting
  • syntax error checking
  • semantic error checking
  • navigation window
  • goto-declaration
  • find usages
  • rename tokens
  • rename rules
  • comment grammar rule lines with meta-/ (1.7)
  • save parse trees as svg/jpg/png; right click in parse tree view (1.9)
  • grammar/comment folding (1.7)
  • generates parser code; shortcut (ctrl-shift-G / meta-shift-G) but it's in Tools menu and popups.
  • code completion for tokens, rule names;
  • finds tokenVocab option for code gen if there is a tokenVocab option, don't warn about implicit tokens.
  • handles separate parsers and lexers like TParser.g4 and TLexer.g4 (1.7)
  • parse tree nodes show the alternative number the parser chose to match that node. (1.7)
  • has live grammar interpreter for grammar preview. Right click on rule and say "Test ANTLR Rule". Please noteThat actions and semantic predicates in the grammar or not executed during this preview!
  • view parse trees in hierarchy (sideways tree) view. (1.8)
  • can view parse trees for input matched in more than one way (ambiguities) (1.7)
  • can view lookahead trees to show how input directed ANTLR to match a particular alternative (1.7)
  • changes to grammar seen in parse tree upon save of grammar.
  • works with all JetBrains IDEs (1.8)
  • refactoring: extract rule, inline rule (1.8), dup rule to make refs unique

Generates code in /gen/package/YourGrammarRecognizer.java unless you override in the configuration dialog. Shortcut to generate parsers is ctrl-shift-G / meta-shift-G but it's in Tools menu, popups. Code completion for tokens, rule names. finds tokenVocab option for code gen if there is a tokenVocab option, don't warn about implicit tokens. shortcut conflicted with grammar-kit plugin. Has live grammar interpreter for grammar preview. Right click on rule and say "Test ANTLR Rule". Changes to grammar seen in parse tree upon save of grammar.

You can configure the ANTLR tool options per grammar file; right-click in a grammar or on a grammar element within the structured view. When you change and save a grammar, it automatically builds with ANTLR in the background according to the preferences you have set. ANTLR tool errors appear in a console you can opened by clicking on a button in the bottom tab.

You can use the ctrl-key while moving the mouse and it will show you token information in the preview editor box via tooltips.

Errors within the preview editor are now highlighted with tooltips and underlining just like a regular editor window. The difference is that this window's grammar is specified in your grammar file.

See README.md for more details.

For really big files and slow grammars, there is an appreciable delay when displaying the parse tree or profiling information.

idea-plugin.change-notes:
Requires IntelliJ 2026.2 or later and Java 25.

  • New: in plain IntelliJ projects (not imported from Gradle or Maven), Build, Rebuild and run configurations generate recognizers from changed grammars before compiling, with ANTLR's errors in the Build tool window. The output directory (gen by default) must be a source root: when it isn't, a notification offers to mark it as a generated sources root. For generation on save, turn on Actions on Save > Build project.
  • New: Refactor > Extract Rule can replace every occurrence of the selection, suggests a name, and explains why a selection can't be extracted (part of an element, left recursion, labels used by actions elsewhere, partly labelled alternatives).
  • New: Code > Reformat Code formats grammars in one house style (whole file or selected lines).
  • New: Code > Sort Parser Rules sorts parser rules alphabetically, keeping the start rule first.
  • New: the "Grammar lint (antlr4-xl)" inspection finds unused rules, duplicate alternatives, unnecessary parentheses and more, with quick fixes and "fix all in file".
  • New: renaming the preview's start rule keeps it as the start rule (after saving the grammar).
  • New: the preview's Tokens tab lists the token stream (type, text, position, channel), with the text between tokens that skip rules dropped or no rule matched; selecting a row selects its text in the input. A lexer grammar on its own now previews too: its input is tokenized and shown in the Tokens tab.
  • Changed: switching editor tabs no longer saves the grammar; the preview follows your saves (Save All, or the IDE's autosave). To see unsaved files, turn on Settings > Editor > General > Editor Tabs > Mark modified (*).
  • Changed: saving a grammar no longer runs the ANTLR tool or writes .tokens files. Generated code comes from Generate ANTLR Recognizer or your build. The "Auto-generate parsers upon save" option is gone.
  • Changed: Generate ANTLR Recognizer reports in a notification (where the files went, or the errors with a link to the first) instead of the Tool Output window, and no longer says "generated" when ANTLR reported errors. In a Gradle or Maven module it generates nothing, since that build generates; "Generate anyway" is offered.
  • New: when a .tokens file left beside the grammars (by an older version of this plugin, for example) would be used instead of the generated one, Generate ANTLR Recognizer offers to delete it, and the build warns.
  • Fixed: Generate ANTLR Recognizer and Test Rule save all open files first; Generate on an unsaved grammar generated nothing.
  • Fixed: the preview refreshes when a grammar it uses changes outside the editor (VCS checkout, another editor), or is created, deleted, moved or renamed.
  • Fixed: implicit-token warnings in a parser grammar with tokenVocab follow the lexer grammar as edited, not a possibly stale generated .tokens file.
  • Fixed: deleting the preview's start rule now falls back to the first rule instead of none.
  • Fixed: lexer alternatives made only of commands (X : -> skip ;) were reported as syntax errors.
  • Fixed: with several projects open, saving a grammar in one could refresh another's preview.
  • Fixed: the preview reparsed slowly on large grammars (about 0.3 s per keystroke on a 1,800-rule grammar); parses now reuse the grammar's prediction cache, so only the first parse after loading pays that.
  • New: the preview shows a spinner over its results while a grammar loads or a parse takes more than a moment, so a large grammar no longer looks hung.
  • Fixed: typing in a large grammar was slow, and could color the rest of the file as errors after an edit inside options { }. Brace matching no longer covers braces inside actions and [...].
  • Fixed: clicking a row in the Profiler threw an exception.
  • Fixed: grammar analysis and refactorings no longer freeze the editor on large grammars.
  • The plugin can be enabled or disabled without restarting the IDE.
  • Removed the ANTLR live templates.
